## Download and install (no terminal needed)

**Claude app or Gemini app:** download the `.zip` of each skill you want (for example `agency-orchestrator.zip`, `agency-client-billing.zip`, `agency-cash-forecast.zip`) and upload it as is, without unzipping.
- Claude: claude.ai → Customize → Skills → upload. Code execution must be on.
- Gemini: gemini.google.com → Settings → Skills → Upload (personal Google accounts).

**ChatGPT (GPT or Project) or Gemini Gem:** paste `assistant-instructions.txt` into the instructions field and upload `agency-erp-knowledge.md` and `agency_tools.py` as knowledge files.

`agency-erp-all-skills.zip` contains all 42 skill zips. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Step-by-step guide: [README (English)](https://github.com/afelipeg/agentic-advertising-agency-erp#readme) · [README (español)](https://github.com/afelipeg/agentic-advertising-agency-erp/blob/main/README.es.md)
